keyPoints: Jo cheez jagah gher ti hai aur jisme bhaar hota hai, use padarth (matter) kehte hain — kursi, hawa, paani aur loha sab padarth hain.
Padarth teen avsthaon me hota hai — thos, drav aur gas; inke kanon ki vyavastha, doori aur gati alag-alag hoti hai.
Thos ke kan sabse paas-paas aur kas kar bandhe hote hain, isiliye uska aakaar aur aaytan dono pakke hote hain.
Drav ke kan thode door aur dheele hote hain — wo behta hai aur bartan ka aakaar le leta hai, par uska aaytan nahi badalta.
Gas ke kan bahut door-door aur tez gati me hote hain — wo pure bartan me fail jaati hai aur dabaane par sikud jaati hai.
Taap badhane par kanon ki gati badhti hai aur aakarshan kamzor padta hai, jisse padarth ek avstha se doosri me badal jaata hai.
Aam galti: hawa ko padarth na manna; hawa me bhaar hota hai aur wo jagah gherti hai — gubbare ko phulao, uska aakaar aur bhaar dono badhte hain.
subject: Science
title: Hamare Aas-Paas ka Padarth
